description: Header file defining the QuicPacketNumber class, which manages packet number representation, initialization state, and related operations in the QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: QuicPacketNumber
classes.description: Represents a QUIC packet number, which can be initialized or uninitialized, with methods for comparison, increment, decrement, and conversion.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the packet number to an uninitialized state.

methods.name: UpdateMax
methods.description: Updates the packet number to a new value if it is greater than the current value.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Returns a hash of the packet number.

methods.name: ToUint64
methods.description: Converts the packet number to a uint64_t.

methods.name: IsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the packet number is initialized.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the packet number.
